# workflow-shape.txt — the floor under the step-order rule of check-workflows. Fewer workflows or
# jobs than this is exit 2, not a pass: a shallow checkout, a moved directory or a
# narrowed pathspec all look like "nothing to judge". Regenerated by whoever adds
# or removes a workflow or a job; check-workflows (LibreSCRS/ci) prints the job count.
min_workflows 2
min_jobs 6
